author: H. K. Thomas
title: 35 Asian students enrolled in New London School District in 2024-25 school year
text:
There were 35 Asian students enrolled in New London School District in the 2024-25 school year, 12.9% more than in the previous year, according to the Connecticut State Department of Education .
Data showed that New London School District welcomed 2,918 students during the 2024-25 school year. Among them, Asian students comprised 1.2% of the student body to be the third least represented ethnicity in the district.
New London School District roughly covers schools within New London County and has a main office in New London.
Among the eight public schools in New London School District, Nathan Hale Arts Magnet School recorded the highest enrollment of Asian students in the 2024-25 school year, with a total of 8 students.
Connecticut’s public school enrollment has been in continuous decline over the past decade, falling to an estimated 508,402 students in the 2024-25 school year, according to state data . That represents a drop of about 4,250 students from the prior year and roughly 33,400 fewer students than a decade ago, extending a long-running downward trend in statewide enrollment.
A similar pattern also appears in nonpublic schools. Data from the Connecticut State Department of Education shows about 53,000 students were enrolled in nonpublic schools in 2023-24, slightly fewer than in 2019-20 and well below levels in the late 2010s.
